invariants: A tracked Python symlink never enters the frozen source-read allowlist.
Reading through an excluded source symlink remains an undeclared data read.
An unrelated historical source symlink cannot prevent a conforming stage from starting.

findings.counterexample: One unrelated tracked absolute Python symlink caused source allowlist construction to reject every governed stage.
findings.repair: Exclude tracked Python symlinks from the allowlist and let the observer reject them only if stage code attempts to read them.
